title: Microsoft brings its fourth Indian cloud region online in Hyderabad, the first delivery against a $17.5 billion commitment
summary: Microsoft has brought its fourth Indian cloud region online in Hyderabad, declaring general availability of India South Central on August 6. A region going live and every Azure and Microsoft 365 workload being available in it are two different milestones.
